title: chore(jest): update and add linter
body:
Add eslint-jest-linter to have an error if some tests are skipped.

Other new features are described here: https://facebook.github.io/jest/blog/2017/02/21/jest-19-immersive-watch-mode-test-platform-improvements.html

I put error, even for "skipped" tests. They recommend warn.
What's your thoughts about that?

One use case I see for the "warn" is: if you have a test that is failing for an unknown (or known but hard to fix) reason, and you still want to merge.
